Monthly Gross and Net GST Collection Comparison (FY 2024-25 and 2025-26)

Source: R/data.R
gross_net_collection.Rd

National-level monthly comparison of gross and net GST collection against the same month of the prior year, with component-level breakdowns for domestic collections and IGST on imports. Covers April 2024 to February 2026. Values in Rs. Crore.

gross_net_collection

Format

A data.table with 23 rows. Key columns include:

financial_year

character. Financial year.

month

character. Month in "YYYY-MM".

month_date

Date. First day of the month.

dom_cgst_cur

numeric. Domestic CGST, current month (Rs. Crore).

dom_sgst_cur

numeric. Domestic SGST, current month.

dom_igst_cur

numeric. Domestic IGST, current month.

dom_cess_cur

numeric. Domestic Cess, current month.

gross_domestic_cur

numeric. Gross domestic GST, current month.

imp_igst_cur

numeric. IGST on imports, current month.

gross_total_cur

numeric. Total gross GST (domestic + imports).

refund_cur

numeric. Refunds issued, current month.

net_cur

numeric. Net revenue after refunds, current month.

*_prior

numeric. Prior-year same-month values for each column above.

Source

Ministry of Finance, Government of India. https://www.gst.gov.in

Examples

data(gross_net_collection)
gross_net_collection[, .(month, gross_domestic_cur, refund_cur)]
